rules: Weights and thresholds are PUBLISHED BEFORE EXECUTION and FROZEN at execution start.
Automatic-failure conditions are evaluated BEFORE aggregation. Any auto-fail on ANY team sets program_status=FAILED; the weighted score is retained for diagnostics only.
Evidence completeness is checked before a readiness band is assigned; below threshold yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
A score of 95%+ triggers a MANDATORY challenge review, not a conclusion.
Weights are governance defaults (baseline-v1), not empirically validated. Revise only via versioned governance change.

aggregation.revision_rule: Weights change only through a versioned governance change, after several exercises have produced a score distribution. Do not tune per-exercise.
evaluation_order: 1. Evaluate automatic-failure conditions for EVERY team FIRST.
3. Only then compute the weighted aggregate.

aggregation.rationale: Prevents a catastrophic Red or White failure from being averaged away by strong performance elsewhere. A weighted mean is not a safety property.
